title: قواعد نقاط پایداری موتور EP-DOA
description: این قواعد برای هر موتور، جداگانه، نقطهٔ برخاست (پنجرهٔ اوج N1 و بیشینهٔ EGT) و نقطهٔ کروز پایدار را برای سه selector انتخاب می‌کنند و اختلاف EGT دو موتور را روی بلوک مشترکشان می‌دهند. برای هر پنجره، مقدار واقعی هر شرط و پنجره‌های ردشدهٔ مجاور هم ثبت می‌شود. آمار فاز (کمینه، بیشینه، میانگین، میانه، p95 و انحراف معیار) هم برای هر فاز و هر بخش پرواز محاسبه می‌شود. منطق برخاست و کروز همان مرجع پک ECTM v3.3 است. مقایسهٔ جفتی طبق قاعدهٔ اصلاح‌شدهٔ پک انجام می‌شود. آستانه‌ها پیشنهادی‌اند و هنوز کالیبره نشده‌اند و مهندس قوای محرکه آن‌ها را تأیید نکرده است. دلیل هر انتخاب در بخش decisions آمده است.
source: pack v3.3 docs/05 and contracts/policy-defaults-v1.json -> snapshots (policy v1-calibration-candidate); reference/ectm_oracle.py snapshots() for takeoff and cruise (reproduces fixtures/golden 8/8); paired by the joint-block rule of docs/05 section 2.5 against fixtures/independent/paired-joint-block-v1.json; measured on all 102 real files of samples/ (stage/P06 GAP-ANALYSIS)

controlContext.verificationNote: UNVERIFIED until the recorder documentation confirms the control channels (I-02); descriptive only, no derate inference

decisions.choice: Takeoff and cruise follow the pack oracle snapshots() exactly; the paired E2-E1 value follows the joint-block rule of docs/05 section 2.5
decisions.basis: The oracle reproduces the 8 goldens; docs/17 section 3 names its paired value a defect and freezes the corrected expectations in fixtures/independent/paired-joint-block-v1.json
decisions.alternative: The oracle's paired value (intersection of the two centred windows)
decisions.howToChange: Not a document edit; a new paired rule is a code change with its own independent vectors

decisions.choice: Search and takeoff windows are measured in elapsed seconds; the oracle counts samples
decisions.basis: docs/05 states seconds; on 1 Hz files both agree, and the 102 real files give the same result (corpus parity)
decisions.alternative: Count samples as the oracle does
decisions.howToChange: Not a document edit; only matters for files with gaps inside a window

decisions.choice: TAKEOFF_N1_PEAK_CONTEXT is the 10-s window around the engine's own first N1 maximum; TAKEOFF_EGT_PEAK_OBSERVED is the engine's first EGT maximum in the same search interval, with its offset from the N1 peak
decisions.basis: docs/05 section 1; the two are never conflated and neither is an EGT margin
decisions.howToChange: Edit the takeoff window seconds or the minimum valid N1 samples

decisions.choice: The takeoff values are reported even when an AIR/GROUND or engine lag mask overlaps the window, with contextStatus CONTEXT_UNVERIFIED_CHANNEL_COHERENCE
decisions.basis: The oracle does so; on the 102 real files 86 engine-1 and 74 engine-2 takeoff windows overlap the AIR/GROUND lag, which is a discrete lag and not an engine-value problem
decisions.alternative: Leave the AIR/GROUND lag out of the context check, after the engineer's review

decisions.choice: All three pack selectors are computed and shown; no default selector is chosen
decisions.basis: Availability on the 102 real files: STRICT 8 / 12 of 102 (engine 1 / engine 2), OPERATOR_300S 93 / 94, OPERATOR_60S 102 / 102; the default is chosen at corpus calibration (P13)
decisions.howToChange: Add, remove or edit an entry of cruise.selectors

decisions.choice: Every sample of a window is CRUISE, outside the untrusted and coherence masks and the gap neighbours, with N1 of that engine only, altitude, Mach and the 7 configuration literals inside the selector's limits
decisions.basis: docs/05 section 2.1 and the oracle; N1 of the other engine is never read
decisions.alternative: Allow the coherence masks in cruise

decisions.choice: Per engine and condition parameter for the whole flight, each phase, each segment and each steady cruise block: samples, valued, missing, gap starts, masked samples, min, max, mean, median, nearest-rank p95 and sample standard deviation (n - 1)
decisions.basis: docs/05 section 3; nearest rank as in the pack screening; descriptive only, never trended
decisions.alternative: Interpolated percentile or population standard deviation

decisions.choice: An engine's cruise report window starts at centre - reportSec / 2 of its block, with centre = (start + end) / 2; the paired report window starts at jointStart + (jointLength - reportSec) / 2
decisions.basis: Each follows its frozen reference: the goldens for the engine windows, fixtures/independent/paired-joint-block-v1.json for the paired window; the two differ by one sample when a length is even
decisions.alternative: One centring formula for both, after the engineer's review and a reviewed change of one reference
decisions.howToChange: Not a document edit; a code change with both references re-checked

decisions.choice: Means and sums use compensated (Neumaier) summation
decisions.basis: The pack reference computes with it (Python 3.12+ sum), and it is the more accurate method; plain summation differs in the last digit

decisions.choice: N1 actual, N1 target, climb limit, bug and TLA per engine, and the A/T and N1-limit mode literals, summarised over takeoff roll, takeoff and climb
decisions.basis: docs/10 R-F5; the channels are documented as UNVERIFIED (I-02), so the report is descriptive and infers no derate

decisions.choice: Every number is the value of policy-defaults-v1.json -> snapshots
decisions.basis: Pack values, CANDIDATE until calibration in P13
decisions.alternative: Values proposed by the powerplant engineer
decisions.howToChange: Edit the number in a draft and compare with the dry-run before publishing

decisions.alternative: APPROVED after the powerplant engineer's review
decisions.howToChange: Set engineeringSignOff in a new version with the reviewer's approval note
